verdict.rationale: Veo has a documented Gemini API video endpoint. It turns text prompts and images into videos, supports multi-input reasoning, and allows multi-turn conversational editing through the Interactions API, so core generation and editing are programmatic. Nothing documents that the API matches everything available in the consumer UIs (Gemini app, Google Flow), and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API-to-UI feature parity, coverage of Flow-specific UI features via the API, a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It excels at quickly turning text prompts and images into short videos, and lets you refine results across multiple turns using the Interactions API.
multi-input reasoning (supporting text, images, audio, and video inputs simultaneously), character consistency... multi-turn conversational editing (e.g., element replacement or perspective changes)
Amazing that something as computationally expensive as generating 8-second videos is available in Gemini/Whisk, outside a paid API.
